The '''27th Annual Latin Grammy Awards''' ceremony will be held on November 12, 2026, at the [[MGM Grand Garden Arena]] in Las Vegas.<ref name=":0">{{Cite magazine |last=Roiz |first=Jessica |date=March 25, 2026 |title=Latin Recording Academy Unveils New Category & Eligibility Guidelines for 2026 Latin Grammys |url=https://www.billboard.com/music/awards/latin-grammys-2026-new-eligibility-guidelines-1236206544/ |access-date=August 27, 2026 |magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]}}</ref> The awards will honor the best recordings and compositions released between June 1, 2025, and May 31, 2026, as selected by the members of [[the Latin Recording Academy]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=March 25, 2026 |title=The Latin Recording Academy® Announces New Eligibility Guidelines For The 27th Annual Latin GRAMMY Awards®, Set To Take Place On Nov. 12 |url=https://www.latingrammy.com/en/news/the-latin-recording-academy-announces-new-eligibility-guidelines-for-the-27th-annual-latin-grammy-awards-set-to-take-place-on-nov-12/ |access-date=August 27, 2026 |publisher=Latin Grammys}}</ref> Puerto Rican actress [[Roselyn Sánchez]] will serve as hosts for the tenth time.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mena |first=Vanessa |date=October 20, 2026 |title=Roselyn Sánchez regresa como host de Latin GRAMMY 2026 |trans-title=Roselyn Sánchez returns as host of 2026 Latin GRAMMY |url=https://www.univision.com/shows/latin-grammy/latin-grammy-2026-roselyn-sanchez-es-la-primera-host-confirmada |access-date=October 21, 2026 |publisher=[[Univision]] |language=es}}</ref>

Puerto Rican rapper and singer [[Daddy Yankee]] was announced as this year's [[Latin Recording Academy Person of the Year]]. [[Latin Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award|Lifetime Achievement Award]] will be presented to Spanish singer [[Alaska (singer)|Alaska]], Cuban musician [[Francisco Céspedes]], Mexican singer-songwriter [[Lila Downs]], Brazilian singer-songwriter [[Daniela Mercury]], and Dominican musician [[Chichí Peralta]]. Panamanian singer-songwriter [[Omar Alfanno]] will receive the Trustee Award. 

For the second time, American songwriter and producer [[Edgar Barrera]] led the nominations with ten, followed by [[Jorge Drexler]], [[Rosalía]], [[Karol G]], and [[Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso]], all with seven each. Other multiple nominees include [[Mon Laferte]] and [[Silvana Estrada]], both with six nominations each, and [[Milo J]] with five. 

== Background ==
In March 2026, the [[The Latin Recording Academy|Latin Recording Academy]] announced several changes for different categories:<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=March 25, 2026 |title=27th Annual Latin Grammy Awards Rules & Guidelines |url=https://naras.a.bigcontent.io/v1/static/LG27_Rules_Guidelines |access-date=August 30, 2026 |publisher=[[The Latin Recording Academy]]}}</ref>

=== Category changes ===
* The following three categories were renamed: [[Latin Grammy Award for Best Electronic Music Performance|Best Latin Electronic Music Performance]] into Best Electronic Music Performance, [[Latin Grammy Award for Best Urban Performance|Best Urban/Urban Fusion Performance]] into Best Urban Performance, and [[Latin Grammy Award for Best Classical Contemporary Composition|Best Classical Contemporary Composition]] into Best Classical Composition. Additionally, the category for [[Latin Grammy Award for Best Portuguese-Language Urban Performance|Best Portuguese-Language Urban Performance]] was changed to an album category and renamed Best Portuguese Language Urban Album.
* Eligibility requirements for the [[Latin Grammy Award for Best New Artist|Best New Artist]] category were slightly changed. Now, an artist is not eligible for consideration if they have released more than three albums, or 25 singles, or a combination of albums and singles that surpasses these limits.
* For the [[Latin Grammy Award for Best Instrumental Album|Best Instrumental Album]], vocals can be used in up to 40% of the total playing time, while requiring that at least 60% of the work remain instrumental.
* For the categories from the Singer-Songwriter field, a singer-songwriter may compose and perform some songs with a colleague, provided the required participation percentages are met. Specifically for the [[Latin Grammy Award for Best Singer-Songwriter Album|Best Singer-Songwriter Album]] category, the artist(s) must both write and perform together on at least 75% of the album for it to be eligible.
* For the [[Latin Grammy Award for Best Contemporary Tropical Album|Best Contemporary Tropical Album]], albums influenced by or belonging to [[Compas|Kompa Haitiano]] are now included.

== Nominees ==
The nominations were announced on September 16, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ratner-Arias |first=Sigal |date=2026-09-16 |title=Edgar Barrera Leads 2026 Latin Grammy Nominations: Full List |url=https://www.billboard.com/lists/latin-grammys-2026-nominations-full-list/ |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=Billboard |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=September 16, 2026 |title=Final Nominations – 27th Annual Latin Grammy Awards |url=https://media-latin.grammy.net/uploads/2026/01/27th-LG-Nominees.pdf |access-date=September 16, 2026 |publisher=[[The Latin Recording Academy]]}}</ref> Past winners [[Aitana (singer)|Aitana]], Renee, Camilo Sanabria, [[BaianaSystem]], César Orozco, [[Paloma Morphy]], [[Luis Enrique (singer)|Luis Enrique]], [[Eduardo Cabra]], [[Liniker]], [[Jorge Drexler]], [[Natalia Lafourcade]], and Nico Cotton, all revealed the nominees in a livestream on the official Latin Grammy ''[[X (social network)|X]]'' account.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-01 |title=2026 Latin Grammy Nominations & Nominees - 27th Annual Latin Grammys |url=https://www.latingrammy.com/en/awards/27th-annual-latin-grammy-awards/ |access-date=2026-09-22 |website=Latin Grammys |language=en-US}}</ref>
